scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run copy:wasm
scripts.copy:wasm: rm -rf web/wasm && mkdir -p web/wasm && cp wasm/pkg/metadata_remover.js wasm/pkg/metadata_remover_bg.wasm web/wasm/
scripts.check:rust: cd wasm && cargo fmt -- --check && cargo test --locked && cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo audit --deny warnings
scripts.check:wasm-determinism: tmp="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/metadata-remover-wasm-determinism-$$" && rm -rf "$tmp" web/wasm wasm/pkg && mkdir -p "$tmp" && npm run build && cp web/wasm/metadata_remover_bg.wasm "$tmp/first.wasm" && rm -rf web/wasm wasm/pkg && npm run build && cmp "$tmp/first.wasm" web/wasm/metadata_remover_bg.wasm && rm -rf "$tmp"
scripts.check:js: node --check web/js/app.js && node --check web/js/download-names.js && node --check web/js/file-lifecycle.js && node --check web/js/memory-budget.js && node --check web/js/metadata-modal.js && node --check web/js/metadata-summary.js && node --check web/js/sample-jpeg.js && node --check web/js/visual-verification-queue.js && node --check web/js/worker-errors.js && node --check web/js/worker-state.js && node --check web/js/worker.js && node --check web/js/zip-download.js && node --check test/metadata-ui.test.js && node --check test/hosting.test.js && node --check test/docs.test.js
scripts.test: npm run check:js && npm run build && npm run test:js
scripts.dist: npm run build && rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -R web/. dist/
scripts.release-check: npm run check:rust && npm run check:wasm-determinism && npm test && npm run dist
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run serve
